senses.definition: A small, usually uncultivated area adjoining or (now especially) within the precincts of a house or other building.
The property surrounding one's house, typically dominated by one's lawn.
An enclosed outdoors area designated for a specific purpose, e.g. on farms, railways etc.
A place where moose or deer herd together in winter for pasture, protection, etc.
The totality of the sailing rig.
examples: Her yards were bare and cockabill.

senses.definition: Expressing joy, celebration, glee, etc.
examples: Yeah! We did it!

senses.definition: A period of time akin to the time taken for the Earth to undergo a full cycle of seasons.
examples: We moved to this town a year ago; I quit smoking exactly one year ago.

senses.definition: The time taken for the Earth to return to the same position along the ecliptic, completing a full cycle of seasons; a tropical year or solar year.
The time taken for the Earth to orbit the Sun with respect to the fixed stars; a sidereal year.
The length of twelve lunations; the time taken for any moon phase to happen twelve times; a lunar year.
A very long time.
examples: It took years for the bus to come.

senses.definition: The color of sunflower petals and lemons; the color obtained by mixing green and red light, or by subtracting blue from white light; the color evoked by light of wavelength around 580 nm; one of the three primary colors in subtractive color systems.
The middle light in a set of three traffic lights, the lighting of which indicates that drivers should stop short of the intersection if it is safe to do so.
One of the color balls used in snooker, with a value of 2 points.

One of two groups of object balls, or a ball from that group, as used in the principally British version of pool that makes use of unnumbered balls (the yellow(s) and red(s)); contrast stripes and solids in the originally American version with numbered balls).
Yes.
Yes.
examples: I'll take that as a yep, then.

senses.definition: An exclamation of pleasure or approval, usually transcribed with an exclamation point.
examples: Our second goal of the match! Yes!

senses.definition: Response that confirms that the user is paying attention.
Used to ask for more information with a request.
examples: I need some help. Yes?

senses.definition: An affirmative expression; an answer that shows agreement or acceptance.
examples: Was that a yes?

senses.definition: The day immediately before today; one day ago.
examples: Today is the child of yesterday and the parent of tomorrow.
Yesterday was rainy, but by this morning it had begun to snow.

senses.definition: The past, often in terms of being outdated.
examples: Yesterday's technology.
The worker of today is different from that of yesterday.

senses.definition: On the day before today.
examples: I started to watch the video yesterday, but could only finish it this evening.

senses.definition: As soon as possible.
examples: I want this done yesterday!
I need it yesterday!

senses.definition: In negative or interrogative use, often with an expectation or potential of something happening in the future.
examples: I haven't finished yet.
Have you finished yet?
We do not yet know what happened.

senses.definition: In negative imperative use, asking for an action to be delayed.
examples: Don't switch it on yet – wait until I've reconnected the pump.

senses.definition: At some future time; eventually.
examples: The riddle will be solved yet.

senses.definition: Not as of the time referenced.
examples: I’ve yet to see him. — I have not yet seen him.
I had yet to go to a convention. — I had not yet gone to a convention.
They are yet to win a single match. — They have not yet won a single match.

senses.definition: To give as a result or outcome; to produce or render.
examples: This method generally yields better results.
The new variety of potatoes yields 20% more.

senses.definition: To produce as return from an investment.
examples: Historically, that security yields a high return.

senses.definition: To produce as a result.
examples: Adding 3 and 4 yields a result of 7.

senses.definition: To produce a particular sound as the result of a sound law.
examples: Indo-European p- yields Germanic f-.

senses.definition: To bowl a yorker at a batsman, especially to get a batsman out in this way.
To vomit.
examples: BADGER: They're eating blueberry pies... […] Okay, finally, Kirk, he can't take it anymore. He yorks! Now it's just down to Chekov and Spock.

senses.definition: The people spoken, or written to, as an object.
examples: Both of you should get ready now.
I'll look up you and your sister.

senses.definition: (To) yourselves, (to) yourself.
The person spoken to or written to, as an object. (Replacing thee; originally as a mark of respect.).
The people spoken to or written to, as a subject. (Replacing ye.).
examples: You are all supposed to do as I tell you.
Are you excited? ― Yes, I am excited!

senses.definition: In the early part of growth or life; born not long ago.
examples: A lamb is a young sheep.
These picture books are for young readers.
Come skydiving with us. Come on, you're only young once!

senses.definition: At an early stage of existence or development; having recently come into existence.
examples: The age of space travel is still young.
A young business.

senses.definition: Advanced in age; (far towards or) at a specified stage of existence or age.
examples: How young is your dog?
Her grandmother turned 70 years young last month.

senses.definition: Junior (of two related people with the same name).
Synonym of junior.
One who is younger than another.
Most recently begun or formed.
examples: I may be the youngest in my family but I still resent being referred to as the baby.

senses.definition: Receiving dealt cards last, i.e. immediately before the next deal to the eldest.
The youngest child in a family, or individual in a group.
Belonging to you; of you; related to you (singular; one owner).
examples: Let’s meet tomorrow at your convenience.
Is this your cat?

senses.definition: Belonging to you; of you; related to you (plural; more owners).
A determiner that conveys familiarity and mutual knowledge of the modified noun.
examples: Not your average Tom, Dick and Harry.
Your Show of Shows.
Your World with Neil Cavuto.

senses.definition: That; the specified (usually used with a human referent).
examples: Your man just bought a new car.
Have you seen what your one over there is doing?

senses.definition: That or those belonging to you; the possessive second-person singular pronoun used without a following noun.
examples: If this edit is mine, the other must be yours.
Their encyclopedia is good, but yours is even better.
Are all these socks yours?

senses.definition: Your house or home.
examples: Let's go over to yours.

senses.definition: Written at the end of a letter, before the signature.
examples: Yours sincerely, Yours faithfully, Yours, Sincerely yours.

senses.definition: Your own self (singular).
examples: Be careful with that fire or you'll burn yourself.
After a good night's sleep you'll feel like yourself again.

senses.definition: You (singular); used emphatically, especially to indicate exclusiveness of the referent's participation in the predicate, i.e., that no one else is involved.
examples: You yourself know that what you wrote was wrong.

senses.definition: You (singular); even when "you" has not been used previously; see usage notes.
examples: I spoke with yourself last in February.
No one understands me like yourself.
My colleague and yourself are invited to the conference.

senses.definition: Oneself.
examples: These days you have to watch yourself in the center of the city.

senses.definition: The quality or state of being young.
examples: Her youth and beauty attracted him to her.

senses.definition: The part of life following childhood; the period of existence preceding maturity or age; the whole early part of life, from childhood, or, sometimes, from infancy, to adulthood.
examples: Make the most of your youth, it will not last forever.
I made many mistakes in my youth, but learned from them all.

senses.definition: A young person.
examples: There was a group of youths hanging around the parking lot, reading fashion magazines and listening to music.

senses.definition: A young man; a male adolescent or young adult.
A yes; an affirmative answer.
Yes.
